verses.greek: ἴδετε ποταπὴν ἀγάπην δέδωκεν ἡμῖν ὁ πατὴρ ἵνα τέκνα θεοῦ κληθῶμεν, καὶ ἐσμέν. διὰ τοῦτο ὁ κόσμος οὐ γινώσκει ἡμᾶς ὅτι οὐκ ἔγνω αὐτόν.
verses.literal: Behold what love has given to us the Father that children of God we may be called — and we are! Because of this the world not knows us because not it knew Him.
verses.dgt: See what kind of love the Father has given us, that we should be called children of God—and we are. Because of this the world does not know us, because it did not know him.

verses.greek: ἀγαπητοί, νῦν τέκνα θεοῦ ἐσμεν, καὶ οὔπω ἐφανερώθη τί ἐσόμεθα. οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἐὰν φανερωθῇ ὅμοιοι αὐτῷ ἐσόμεθα, ὅτι ὀψόμεθα αὐτὸν καθώς ἐστιν.
verses.literal: Beloved now children of God are we and not yet has been revealed what we will be We know that when He shall appear like Him we will be for we will behold Him even as He is.
verses.dgt: Beloved, now we are children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. We know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, because we will see him just as he is.

verses.greek: καὶ πᾶς ὁ ἔχων τὴν ἐλπίδα ταύτην ἐπʼ αὐτῷ ἁγνίζει ἑαυτὸν καθὼς ἐκεῖνος ἁγνός ἐστιν.
verses.literal: And everyone who is having the hope this in Him purifies himself even as He pure is.
verses.dgt: And everyone who has this hope in him purifies himself, just as he is pure.

verses.greek: Πᾶς ὁ ποιῶν τὴν ἁμαρτίαν καὶ τὴν ἀνομίαν ποιεῖ, καὶ ἡ ἁμαρτία ἐστὶν ἡ ἀνομία.
verses.literal: Everyone who is committing the sin also the lawlessness commits and the sin is the lawlessness.
verses.dgt: Everyone who practices sin also practices lawlessness, and sin is lawlessness.

verses.greek: καὶ οἴδατε ὅτι ἐκεῖνος ἐφανερώθη ἵνα τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἄρῃ, καὶ ἁμαρτία ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν.
verses.literal: And you know that He appeared so that the sins He may take away and sin in Him not there is.
verses.dgt: And you know that he was revealed in order to take away sins, and in him there is no sin.

verses.greek: πᾶς ὁ ἐν αὐτῷ μένων οὐχ ἁμαρτάνει· πᾶς ὁ ἁμαρτάνων οὐχ ἑώρακεν αὐτὸν οὐδὲ ἔγνωκεν αὐτόν.
verses.literal: Anyone the in Him abiding not sins anyone who is sinning not has seen Him nor has he known Him.
verses.dgt: Everyone who remains in him does not keep sinning; everyone who keeps sinning has neither seen him nor known him.

verses.greek: τεκνία, μηδεὶς πλανάτω ὑμᾶς· ὁ ποιῶν τὴν δικαιοσύνην δίκαιός ἐστιν, καθὼς ἐκεῖνος δίκαιός ἐστιν·
verses.literal: little children no one should lead astray you who are practicing the righteousness righteous is even as He righteous is.
verses.dgt: Little children, let no one lead you astray. The one who practices righteousness is righteous, just as he is righteous.

verses.greek: ὁ ποιῶν τὴν ἁμαρτίαν ἐκ τοῦ διαβόλου ἐστίν, ὅτι ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς ὁ διάβολος ἁμαρτάνει. εἰς τοῦτο ἐφανερώθη ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ ἵνα λύσῃ τὰ ἔργα τοῦ διαβόλου.
verses.literal: The one practicing the sin of the devil is because from the beginning the devil has been sinning. For this reason was revealed the Son the of God so that He may destroy the works of the devil.
verses.dgt: The one who practices sin is from the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was revealed: to destroy the works of the devil.

verses.greek: πᾶς ὁ γεγεννημένος ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἁμαρτίαν οὐ ποιεῖ, ὅτι σπέρμα αὐτοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ μένει, καὶ οὐ δύναται ἁμαρτάνειν, ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ γεγέννηται.
verses.literal: Anyone who born of the God sin not practices because seed of Him in him abides and not he is able to continue sinning because of the God he has been born.
verses.dgt: Everyone who has been born from God does not keep practicing sin, because his seed remains in him; and he cannot keep sinning, because he has been born from God.

verses.greek: ἐν τούτῳ φανερά ἐστιν τὰ τέκνα τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τὰ τέκνα τοῦ διαβόλου· πᾶς ὁ μὴ ποιῶν δικαιοσύνην οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ ὁ μὴ ἀγαπῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: Through this manifest are the children the of God and the children of the devil. Anyone the not practicing righteousness not is of the God and also the one not loving the brother of him
verses.dgt: By this the children of God and the children of the devil are evident: everyone who does not practice righteousness is not from God, and neither is the one who does not love his brother.

verses.greek: Ὅτι αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἀγγελία ἣν ἠκούσατε ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς, ἵνα ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους·
verses.literal: For this is the message that you have heard from the beginning that we may love one another
verses.dgt: For this is the message that you heard from the beginning: that we should love one another.

verses.greek: οὐ καθὼς Κάϊν ἐκ τοῦ πονηροῦ ἦν καὶ ἔσφαξεν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ· καὶ χάριν τίνος ἔσφαξεν αὐτόν; ὅτι τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ πονηρὰ ἦν, τὰ δὲ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ δίκαια.
verses.literal: not even as Cain who of the evil one was and he slew the brother of him And because of what he slayed him? Because the works of him evil were those however of the brother of him righteous.
verses.dgt: Not like Cain, who was from the evil one and slaughtered his brother. And why did he slaughter him? Because his own works were evil, but his brother’s were righteous.

verses.greek: μὴ θαυμάζετε, ἀδελφοί, εἰ μισεῖ ὑμᾶς ὁ κόσμος.
verses.literal: not do be surprised brothers if hates you the world.
verses.dgt: Do not be surprised, brothers and sisters, if the world hates you.

verses.greek: ἡμεῖς οἴδαμεν ὅτι μεταβεβήκαμεν ἐκ τοῦ θανάτου εἰς τὴν ζωήν, ὅτι ἀγαπῶμεν τοὺς ἀδελφούς· ὁ μὴ ἀγαπῶν μένει ἐν τῷ θανάτῳ.
verses.literal: We ourselves know that we have passed from the death to the life because we love the our brothers The one not loving abides in the death.
verses.dgt: We know that we have passed from death into life because we love the brothers and sisters. The one who does not love remains in death.

verses.greek: πᾶς ὁ μισῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἀνθρωποκτόνος ἐστίν, καὶ οἴδατε ὅτι πᾶς ἀνθρωποκτόνος οὐκ ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον ἐν αὐτῷ μένουσαν.
verses.literal: Everyone who is hating the brother of him a murderer is and you know that any murderer not has life eternal in him abiding.
verses.dgt: Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

verses.greek: ἐν τούτῳ ἐγνώκαμεν τὴν ἀγάπην, ὅτι ἐκεῖνος ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἔθηκεν· καὶ ἡμεῖς ὀφείλομεν ὑπὲρ τῶν ἀδελφῶν τὰς ψυχὰς θεῖναι.
verses.literal: By this we have known the love because He for us the life of Him laid down and we ourselves ought for the our brothers the our lives to lay down.
verses.dgt: By this we have come to know love: he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers and sisters.

verses.greek: ὃς δʼ ἂν ἔχῃ τὸν βίον τοῦ κόσμου καὶ θεωρῇ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ χρείαν ἔχοντα καὶ κλείσῃ τὰ σπλάγχνα αὐτοῦ ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ, πῶς ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ μένει ἐν αὐτῷ;
verses.literal: Whoever now maybe may have the goods of the world and may see the brother of him need having and he may close up the heart of him from him how the love the of God abides in him?
verses.dgt: But whoever has the world’s goods, sees his brother in need, and closes his heart against him—how does the love of God remain in him?

verses.greek: Τεκνία, μὴ ἀγαπῶμεν λόγῳ μηδὲ τῇ γλώσσῃ ἀλλὰ ἐν ἔργῳ καὶ ἀληθείᾳ.
verses.literal: Little children not we may love in word nor the in tongue but in action and in truth.
verses.dgt: Little children, let us not love in word or with the tongue, but in deed and truth.

verses.greek: ἐν τούτῳ γνωσόμεθα ὅτι ἐκ τῆς ἀληθείας ἐσμέν, καὶ ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ πείσομεν τὴν καρδίαν ἡμῶν
verses.literal: by this we will know that of the truth we are and before Him we will assure the heart of us
verses.dgt: By this we will know that we are from the truth, and before him we will reassure our heart,

verses.greek: ὅτι ἐὰν καταγινώσκῃ ἡμῶν ἡ καρδία, ὅτι μείζων ἐστὶν ὁ θεὸς τῆς καρδίας ἡμῶν καὶ γινώσκει πάντα.
verses.literal: that if shall condemn us our the heart that greater than is the God of the heart of us and He knows all things.
verses.dgt: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart and knows all things.

verses.greek: ἀγαπητοί, ἐὰν ἡ καρδία μὴ καταγινώσκῃ ἡμῶν, παρρησίαν ἔχομεν πρὸς τὸν θεόν,
verses.literal: Beloved if the heart not shall condemn us confidence we have toward the God
verses.dgt: Beloved, if our heart does not condemn us, we have confidence before God,

verses.greek: καὶ ὃ ἐὰν αἰτῶμεν λαμβάνομεν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ, ὅτι τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ τηροῦμεν καὶ τὰ ἀρεστὰ ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ποιοῦμεν.
verses.literal: and whatever maybe we shall ask we receive from Him because the commandments of Him we keep and the things pleasing before Him we do.
verses.dgt: and whatever we ask we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do what is pleasing before him.

verses.greek: καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἐντολὴ αὐτοῦ, ἵνα πιστεύσωμεν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους, καθὼς ἔδωκεν ἐντολὴν ἡμῖν.
verses.literal: And this is the commandment of Him that we may believe in the name of the Son of Him Jesus Christ and we may love one another even as He gave the commandment to us.
verses.dgt: And this is his commandment: that we believe in the name of his Son Jesus Christ and love one another, just as he gave us commandment.

verses.greek: καὶ ὁ τηρῶν τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ μένει καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν αὐτῷ· καὶ ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι μένει ἐν ἡμῖν, ἐκ τοῦ πνεύματος οὗ ἡμῖν ἔδωκεν.
verses.literal: And the one keeping the commandments of Him in Him abides and He in him. And by this we know that He abides in us by the Spirit whom to us He has given.
verses.dgt: And the one who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in that person. And by this we know that he remains in us: from the Spirit whom he gave us.
